source_doc.title: AXT Form 8-K — Lumentum Capacity Reservation Agreement for InP wafer substrates

sources.quote: On July 26, 2026, AXT Inc. ... and Lumentum Operations LLC ... entered into a Capacity Reservation Agreement ... for the supply and capacity reservation of indium phosphide ("InP") wafer substrates.

AXT has agreed to reserve a minimum annual commitment of the Products by Lumentum ... for a six (6) year period beginning upon entry into the Agreement and to support any additional capacity that may be required.

Lumentum has agreed to pay AXT (i) an initial deposit of $43,500,000, due within thirty (30) business days after entry into the Agreement, and (ii) a second deposit of $43,500,000, with the timing and terms surrounding payment to be subsequently determined during calendar year 2028.
The deposits shall be applied as shipment credits towards the purchase of the Products, until such deposit is exhausted.
Lumentum shall be responsible for the shortfall between the Annual Purchase Commitment and the quantity actually purchased.

failure to deliver the minimum annual Product Capacity by AXT shall constitute a material breach ... AXT will be required to refund to Lumentum the portion of deposit ... not previously been applied as shipment credits.
The foregoing description of the Agreement does not purport to be complete ... the full text of the Agreement ... will be filed as an exhibit ... for the period ended September 30, 2026.
